app.title: Base Commander
app.tagline: Run a base at the Moon's south pole. Every choice has a cost, and every number comes from real NASA data.

start.sources: Where do the numbers come from?

site.title: Where will you build your base?

rim.name: Crater rim
rim.pro: Almost constant sunlight, even during the lunar night
rim.con: Ice is far away, so water costs energy

shadow.name: Next to the shadowed crater
shadow.pro: Water ice nearby, so water is free
shadow.con: Extreme cold and no sunlight during the lunar night

sys.title: Turn on systems

lifeSupport.name: 🫁 Life support
lifeSupport.desc: Oxygen and water for the crew

sys.pausedShelter: Paused: crew is in the shelter
sys.evaRest: The crew is tired and needs a rest day

reactor.buy: ⚛️ Buy a small reactor ({cost} science points)

shelter.active: 🛡️ The crew is in the shelter today

FLR.title: ☀️ Class {class} solar flare!
FLR.text: The Sun gave off a strong flash. Radiation goes up today.

SEP.title: ⚠️ Solar particle storm!
SEP.text: Fast particles are coming from the Sun. This is the most dangerous thing for astronauts.

CME.title: 📡 Early warning: a solar cloud is coming!
CME.text: The Sun threw out a huge cloud at {speed} km/s. It may arrive in 1 to 3 days. Get ready!

CME_ARRIVAL.title: 🌩️ The solar cloud has arrived!
CME_ARRIVAL.text: The cloud we warned you about has reached the Moon.

event.shelterCost: Dose drops to {dose}, but science and the greenhouse stop today

night.title: 🌑 The lunar night is coming!
night.text: In two days a night begins that lasts 14.5 Earth days, and your site gets no sunlight at night. The battery alone is not enough.
night.cant: You don't have enough points for the reactor. Save energy in the battery and turn off what you don't need.

end.success: 🎉 The crew finished 30 days and came home safely!
end.life: 🚀 The mission returned safely to Earth
end.lifeWhy: Life support ran out. The crew needed more oxygen, water and food than the base could make.
end.radiation: 🚀 The mission returned safely to Earth
end.radiationWhy: The crew collected a high radiation dose. NASA planners would have sent them to the shelter during storms.
